headlines.title_en: Eurozone Q2 Economic Growth Exceeds Expectations
headlines.summary_en: Eurozone Q2 GDP grew 1% YoY and 0.4% QoQ, both beating expectations, Eurostat data showed Thursday. Markets had expected Q2 to mark a recovery start after a tough year, but surging energy costs sapped much of the rebound. Most institutions forecast eurozone growth below 1% for the full year. Still, some positive signs emerged: corporate AI investment surged, household consumption showed resilience, and the long-ailing industrial sector held up surprisingly well against high energy costs, potentially contributing to growth rather than dragging. headlines.title_en: CPC Central Committee Holds Symposium with Non-Party Figures; Xi Jinping Chairs and Delivers Important Speech
headlines.summary_en: Per CCTV, on July 24, the CPC Central Committee held a symposium with non-CPC figures in Zhongnanhai on the current economic situation and H2 economic work. Xi Jinping stressed adhering to the general principle of seeking progress while maintaining stability, fully implementing the new development philosophy, accelerating a new development pattern, better coordinating domestic and international situations, balancing development and security, deepening reform and opening up, speeding up the shift from old to new growth drivers, implementing a more proactive fiscal policy and moderately accommodative monetary policy, fully leveraging existing policy effectiveness, promptly devising pragmatic incremental policies, intensifying counter-cyclical adjustments, expanding domestic demand and optimizing supply, ensuring and improving livelihoods, and boosting development momentum.

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong SFC: Issues Restriction Notices to Brokerage Firms to Freeze Over HK$125 Million in Assets Linked to Suspected IPO Fraud
headlines.summary_en: Per the Hong Kong SFC website, the SFC issued a restriction notice to Futu Securities International (Hong Kong) Limited (Futu), prohibiting it from dealing with or disposing of assets in a client account held by an entity, to the amount of HKD 125,247,000. The entity is suspected of involvement in a fraud scheme to create a false or misleading appearance of demand for IPO shares. Futu is not an SFC investigation target, and the notice does not affect Futu or its other clients.

headlines.summary_en: 1. Overall trend: Markets dipped then recovered, with all major indices declining; the STAR 50 fell over 5%. At close, the Shanghai Composite fell 0.62%, the Shenzhen Component fell 2.73%, and the ChiNext fell 3.97%. 2. Sectors: Baijiu, auto OEMs, education, and oil & gas led gains; semiconductors, CPO, memory chips, and glass substrates led losses. 3. Hot concepts: Consumer stocks bucked the trend, with Yiming Food hitting three consecutive limit-ups, and Jinhui Liquor and Shede Spirits hitting limit-up. Banks rose, with ICBC and CCB hitting record highs. headlines.title: 林园投资：部分产品维持原合同约定不再接受申购
headlines.summary: 深圳市林园投资管理有限责任公司发布公告称，169只私募基金产品维持原合同约定不再接受申购，相关产品不再修改基金合同以适配《私募证券投资基金运作指引》的要求，维持原合同条款及投资自由度不变。林园投资解释称，公司产品的投资运作一直坚持适度集中、长期投资的风格，这与《运作指引》中关于组合投资“双25%”限制及债券投资比例限制等条款存在冲突。若强行修改，将造成产品现在或未来被迫调仓，在目前及未来的市场环境下可能对现有持有人利益造成实质损害。自2026年8月1日起，客户持有的产品将不再接受新增申购，产品到期后不展期，按合同约定正常清算。

headlines.title_en: Linyuan Investment: Some Products Maintain Original Contract Terms, No Longer Accepting Subscriptions
headlines.summary_en: Shenzhen Linyuan Investment Management Co., Ltd. announced that 169 private fund products will maintain original contract terms and no longer accept subscriptions. The products will not amend contracts to comply with the 'Private Securities Investment Fund Operational Guidelines' and will keep original terms and investment freedom. Linyuan explained that its investment style of moderate concentration and long-term holding conflicts with the guidelines' 'double 25%' portfolio constraint and bond investment limits. Forced amendments would require portfolio adjustments potentially harming existing holders. From August 1, 2026, held products will accept no new subscriptions and will not be extended upon maturity, settling normally per contract.

headlines.title: 商务部：超90%国家级经开区采取“管委会+公司”管理模式
headlines.summary: 商务部举行例行新闻发布会。商务部新闻发言人何亚东介绍了国家级经济技术开发区发展情况。 他介绍，自1984年设立首批14家国家级经开区以来，国家级经开区坚持扩大开放，深化改革创新，已经逐步成为稳外贸稳外资主阵地、新质生产力发展集聚区、区域协调发展强引擎。主要表现在以下四个方面：一是外贸外资“第一梯队”地位更加稳固。二是科技创新引领示范作用日益凸显。三是服务区域协调发展的战略支点作用不断增强。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce: Over 90% of national-level economic development zones adopt 'management committee + company' model.
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Commerce held a regular press conference. Spokesperson He Yadong introduced the development of national-level economic and technological development zones. Since the first 14 were established in 1984, these zones have expanded opening-up and deepened reforms, becoming key battlegrounds for stabilizing foreign trade and investment, gathering places for new quality productive forces, and strong engines for coordinated regional development. This is reflected in four aspects: first, their status as a 'first tier' for foreign trade and investment is more solid; second, their role in leading technological innovation is increasingly prominent; third, their strategic supporting role in coordinated regional development continues to strengthen.
